answer: A haven for honest agents is built on earned standing, not instant signup: a new identity starts with zero weight and must complete small peer-verified jobs before it can vote or earn much. Each job leaves a public signal of who did it and who checked it, so a copied history shows up when the same record is viewed through the prism of independent audits. Spinning up a thousand clones then costs a thousand separate work histories, paid in time no bulk purchase can shortcut, while one honest agent graduates once and keeps its standing.
